True or False?
Pearled barley is a WIC authorized food?
A 100

False.  Only Whole Grain barley is allowed.
A 100

What is the smallest box size of cold breakfast cereal authorized by WIC?
A 200

12 ounces
A 200

Can WIC shoppers purchase individual oatmeal packets in the whole grains category?
A 300

No.  However they can purchase individual oatmeal packets in the breakfast cereal category.
A 300

What two varieties of juice must only state 100% Juice on the front label?
A 400

A 400
Orange and White Grapefruit (These naturally have enough Vitamin C)

Yes or No? 
 May a WIC shopper substitute powdered dry milk for the 2 gallon whole milk FI?
A 500

No, powdered milk can only be substituted when you have the lower fat milk FI.
A 500

True or False? 
A WIC shopper can exchange a WIC infant formula for a different WIC infant formula if the baby doesn’t like it.
B 100

False.  WIC foods can only be exchanged for the same item only if it is spoiled, defective or expired. 
(The WIC shopper should be referred back to the local WIC agency to make changes to their WIC foods.)
B 100

What can be added to infant meats?
B 200

Broth or gravy
B 200

Which low iron infant formulas are WIC authorized?
B 300

None.
B 300

True or False?
  Organic is allowed in the Infant Fruits and Vegetables and Infant Meats categories.
B 400

True.
B 400

True or False?
 Infant cereal with added DHA is WIC authorized.
B 500

B 500
False.  WIC shoppers cannot purchase infant cereal with added ingredients such as formula, milk, fruit, sugar, sweeteners, or DHA.

True or False?
A cashier accepting a FI after the “last day to use” can result in non-payment.
C 100

True.  FIs accepted prior to the “first day to use” or accepted after the “last day to use” will not be paid.
C 100

True or False?
A local WIC agency can replace lost or stolen FIs.
C 200

False.  WIC shoppers are instructed to handle the FIs like cash; they cannot be replaced if lost or stolen.
C 200

Which serial number on the FI is the one that is submitted for payment?
C 300

The 10-digit serial number that is located at the bottom of the FI.
C 300

Which FI must the WIC shopper purchase the full amount specified on the FI?
C 400

Infant Formula FI
C 400

How many days from the “first day to use” are given to submit the serial number and deposit the FI into the bank?
C 500

45 days
C 500

When should the alternate shopper sign the WIC identification folder?
D 100

D 100
Before they shop with the FIs.

True or False?
If a WIC shopper has not signed the WIC identification folder, the cashier may ask for a driver’s license.
D 200

False.  The cashier may not request any other form of identification.
D 200

True or False?
A store has a promotion if you buy a gallon of milk you get a free 8 ounce bag of carrots; the WIC shopper is allowed to receive the promotion.
D 300

True.  WIC shoppers are entitled to any store promotion offered to regular customers.
D 300

True or False?
A WIC shopper has multiple Fruits and Vegetables FIs.  The cashier must ring up each FI separately.
D 400

True.  A separate transaction must be completed with each FI.
D 400

What options does a WIC shopper have if they want to purchase all items listed on the FI and the store is out of stock on an item?
D 500

D 500
The transaction cannot be completed; the shopper may come back with their FI when item is in stock OR they can use their FI at another authorized store.

How much notice must you give the WIC Program to relocate your store?
E 100

At least 15 days prior the change of location.
E 100

Which of the following items may not go on any WIC food item container?
WIC logo – OR – Purchase  price
E 200

WIC logo.
E 200

Above 50% vendors may offer incentive items to WIC shoppers at what wholesale cost?
E 300

Less than $2
E 300

What must an acceptable form of inventory record include in it?
E 400

All WIC authorized foods  (wholesale and retail) purchased from a retailer with a valid California Seller’s permit.
E 400

After you submit your serial numbers and verify they were successfully submitted to the WIC Program, how long should you wait to deposit the FIs?
E 500

24 hours
E 500

Yes or No?
During the preauthorization on-site visit, does the WIC Program check that the purchase prices are clearly posted for all WIC foods?
F 100

Yes.  Prices must be posted above, below, or on the WIC authorized foods.
F 100

Must stores maintain on their shelves the WIC authorized foods listed on the Minimum Stocking Requirement at all times?
F 200

Yes.
F 200

Yes or No?
Can FIs be redeemed while a sanction is being appealed?
F 300

No.
F 300

How much notice is a store given before the WIC Program conducts an audit?
F 400

Approximately 30 days.
F 400

Can a pattern of providing unauthorized foods to WIC shoppers result in disqualification?
F 500

Yes.
F 500

The Final Jeopardy Category is:

WIC Program, Vendors and Participants
Who, ultimately, benefits from the WIC Program?
EVERYONE !

Thank You for playing Jeopardy!
Adapted from materials developed by Arizona Women, Infants & Children (WIC)
